import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final long MODULUS = 1000000007L;
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] input = scanner.nextLine().trim().split(" ");
        int p_num = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        int k_num = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);

        if (k_num == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p_num, p_num - 1, MODULUS));
        } else if (k_num == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p_num, p_num, MODULUS));
        } else {
            long n_value = k_num;
            int cycle_len = 1;
            while (n_value != 1) {
                n_value = (n_value * k_num) % p_num;
                cycle_len++;
            }
            long repeats_count = (p_num - 1) / cycle_len;
            System.out.println(powMod(p_num, repeats_count, MODULUS));
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
